2026_01_MIA_LV.headline: Miami’s healthier defense catches Las Vegas without Brock Bowers
2026_01_MIA_LV.paragraph1: Las Vegas opens without Brock Bowers, removing its most difficult coverage matchup and shifting more creation burden onto the Raiders’ backs and remaining pass catchers. Ashton Jeanty returned to practice as a full participant, giving Las Vegas a healthier run-game option, while Miami enters without a game-status injury designation. The Dolphins still have to tackle well and avoid letting the Raiders turn the game into a slow, physical possession battle. If Miami wins early downs, Bowers’ absence becomes far more difficult for Las Vegas to disguise.
2026_01_MIA_LV.model_rationale: Miami owns the cleaner matchup if it controls early downs, while Las Vegas needs Jeanty and its complementary targets to prevent the Dolphins from dictating obvious passing situations.
